intro.es: Prueba el adaptador de Hangul con un diálogo cotidiano breve y ayudas bajo demanda.
intro.en: Try the Hangul adapter with a short everyday dialogue and optional support.

mission.es: Identifica qué bebida pide 민지 y si la quiere caliente o fría.
mission.en: Find out which drink Minji orders and whether she wants it hot or cold.

content.targetText: 직원: 어서 오세요. 무엇을 드릴까요? 민지: 따뜻한 아메리카노 한 잔 주세요. 직원: 여기에서 드세요? 민지: 아니요, 가지고 갈게요. 직원: 네, 사천 원입니다. 민지: 여기 있어요. 감사합니다.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: 직원 어서 오세요 무엇을 드릴까요 민지 따뜻한 아메리카노 한 잔 주세요 직원 여기에서 드세요 민지 아니요 가지고 갈게요 직원 네 사천 원입니다 민지 여기 있어요 감사합니다

objectives.es: Reconocer una bebida y una cantidad en un diálogo breve.
objectives.en: Recognise a drink and a quantity in a short dialogue.

objectives.es: Distinguir consumo en el lugar y para llevar.
objectives.en: Distinguish between drinking in and taking away.

glosses.en: I will take it to go

culturalNote.es: Este diálogo usa un registro cortés frecuente en atención al cliente; no representa la única forma posible de pedir.
culturalNote.en: This dialogue uses a polite register common in customer service; it is not the only possible way to order.

targetCanDo.es: Puedes reconocer una bebida, una cantidad y una decisión sencilla en un diálogo de servicio.
targetCanDo.en: You can recognise a drink, a quantity, and a simple decision in a service dialogue.

independentAssessment.notes: Demonstration fixture for the Hangul adapter; human review remains blocking.

incorrect.es: Busca la bebida después de 따뜻한.
incorrect.en: Look for the drink after 따뜻한.

strategy.es: En un pedido, localiza el sustantivo antes de 주세요.
strategy.en: In an order, find the noun before 주세요.

correct.es: Correcto. 따뜻한 significa caliente o tibio.
correct.en: Correct. 따뜻한 means hot or warm.

strategy.es: Relaciona el adjetivo con la bebida que modifica.
strategy.en: Connect the adjective with the drink it modifies.

correct.es: Correcto. Dice 가지고 갈게요: lo llevará.
correct.en: Correct. She says 가지고 갈게요: she will take it to go.

incorrect.es: Busca la respuesta después de 여기에서 드세요?
incorrect.en: Find the reply after 여기에서 드세요?

strategy.es: Compara la pregunta del empleado con la respuesta de 민지.
strategy.en: Compare the employee’s question with Minji’s answer.

prompt.es: Escribe un pedido de una bebida usando 주세요.
prompt.en: Write a drink order using 주세요.
